outcome_surface.reference_policy: directional correctness at fixed 5000ms horizon using decision/eval midpoint references

claim_boundary.reason: financial_performance is realized campaign cashflow through settlement; outcome_truth is observational fixed-horizon edge realization and should not numerically equal ledger pnl.

maker_fireability.claim_boundary: report_only_maker_fireability_window; active-window counts are derived from maker edge-evaluation rows inside the manifest-configured maker timing gate and paired with raw non-recovery quote_quality_skip event severity bins; maker-facing lifecycle semantics lead with lifecycle-phase and lane authority while legacy stage buckets are compatibility ancestry only
maker_fireability.active_window_viability_claim_boundary: geometry_only_classification; viable vs impossible rows are derived from maker market_probability against manifest sizing floor min_notional/max_shares and do not assign broader causal blame
maker_fireability.active_window_queue_depth_snapshot_claim: queue-depth target burden uses maker edge-evaluation no-submit assignments by target; raw near-threshold vs hard-miss counts come from non-recovery quote_quality_skip event deltas and are a different population

raw_quote_quality_skip_severity.claim_boundary: raw_local_reject_sparks_non_recovery_only; quote_quality_skip events are event-level reject sparks and are not the same population as maker edge-evaluation no-submit assignments

maker_blocker_ledger.claim_boundary: runtime_first_blocker_tribunal; support artifacts may explain but may not outrank the runtime blocker census

TAKER_COMMITMENT.primary_reduction_cause_accounting_note: primary counters match or undercount net decision-to-submit delta
primary counters match or undercount net decision-to-submit delta

taker_intent_gate_posture_matrix.claim_boundary: report_only_taker_intent_gate_posture; values are derived from emitted run events and run fingerprints, not from current profile files

taker_config_gate_posture.claim_boundary: report_only_manifest_config_gate_posture; values are copied from the run manifest config snapshot and do not assert optimality or causal provenance

taker_opportunity_suppression.claim_boundary: report_only_edge_evaluation_attribution; edge buckets are computed from event edge_abs when present, otherwise abs(fair_probability-market_probability)

taker_doctrine_breaches.claim_boundary: report_only_doctrine_breach_counters; values are derived from emitted taker edge-evaluation and order-submit rows; historical recovery block reasons are preserved as lineage only

lifecycle_residue.report_semantics: report_only_lifecycle_residue; accepted exposure rides to settlement and open unfilled orders use cancel-only fail-close

execution_quality_lane_attribution.classification_policy: order_submit reason classified by canonical taker identity helper is taker; reduce_only/preexpiry recovery flags classify recovery; normal TakerCompetitivenessEngine payload classifies normal; remaining order_submit rows are maker to match execution_paths.

execution_quality_decision_reference_lan.claim_boundary: report_only_decision_reference_lane_attribution; fill economics are scored against order_submit decision_reference_midpoint/midpoint, not token_id book joins
